name: Disable PCIe ASPM
description: Disables PCIe Active State Power Management so GPU/PCIe devices don't downclock mid-game.
commands:
reg add "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Power" /v "AspmDisabled" /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f

powercfg /setacvalueindex SCHEME_CURRENT SUB_PROCESSOR PROCTHROTTLEMAX 100
powercfg /setacvalueindex SCHEME_CURRENT SUB_PROCESSOR PROCTHROTTLEMIN 100
powercfg /setactive SCHEME_CURRENT

$keys = & reg.exe query $root /s 2>$null |
 Where-Object { $_ -like 'HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE*\PCI*' -and $_ -match '\Device Parameters(\)?$' } |
 ForEach-Object { $_.Trim() } | Sort-Object -Unique
foreach ($k in $keys) { reg.exe add "$k" /v EnableASPM /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f }

powercfg /setacvalueindex SCHEME_CURRENT SUB_PROCESSOR PROCTHROTTLEMIN 5
powercfg /setactive SCHEME_CURRENT
$root = 'HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Enum'
$keys = & reg.exe query $root /s 2>$null |
 Where-Object { $_ -like 'HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE*\PCI*' -and $_ -match '\Device Parameters(\)?$' } |
 ForEach-Object { $_.Trim() } | Sort-Object -Unique
foreach ($k in $keys) {
 reg.exe delete "$k" /v EnableASPM /f
}
